summary: Standard Italian uses essere for most copular and locative functions; stare is much narrower than Spanish estar, and esserci/c’è handles central existential meanings.

semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: essere for ordinary state predicates; stare is restricted to particular constructions/idioms and regional uses
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: essere/restare/rimanere + result-state predicate according to lexical construction
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: essere for ordinary location in standard Italian
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: essere / tenersi / svolgersi according to event construction
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: essere di / venire da / nationality predicate
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: not default; avere is ordinary possession
